summary.name: Brendan Gregg's Blog
summary.one_liner: A personal blog by systems performance engineer Brendan Gregg, indexing posts on Linux/BSD performance analysis, eBPF tracing, flame graphs and SRE topics.
use_cases: finding eBPF and bpftrace tracing tutorials
looking up Linux observability tool posts
summary.what_it_does: The page is an index of Brendan Gregg's blog posts, listed by date from 2014 to February 2026, with titles only and no post bodies. Titles cover topics such as eBPF and bpf tracing tools (bcc, bpftrace), flame graphs (CPU, off-CPU, differential, AI and GPU variants), Linux perf and ftrace, and Linux load averages. It also links to his Systems Performance 2nd Edition and BPF Performance Tools book pages, plus an About page and an RSS feed. Some recent posts cover career and industry topics such as joining OpenAI and leaving Intel.
notable: Long archive of performance and eBPF tracing posts, with flame graph and bpftrace tutorials
Links to Systems Performance 2nd Ed. and BPF Performance Tools books
caveats: Index page only; the post bodies are not included in this text
Topics are mostly Linux and BSD focused
